style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the metre stick, the road sign and the road are all warm earthy wood and earth browns, so the keys take the stick's own caramel and Enter a berry treat beside it

images.object: deep-caramel varnished wooden stick, blank face
images.why: Stage 'a metre stick beside the metre rung' and Wrong lines 'four metres are four whole sticks laid end to end': the stick is the counted unit of a metre; marks are drawn in code
images.prompt: A long, flat, straight wooden stick lying horizontally across the picture, deep-caramel walnut varnish with fine wood grain and a soft gloss, rounded ends, a darker brown edge and a completely plain smooth face.

images.why: Stage 'a kilometre road sign beside the kilometre rung': the road sign is the object that stands for a kilometre; its words and marks are drawn in code
images.prompt: A blank rectangular wooden road sign plaque with rounded corners, warm golden-tan painted wood, a darker brown rim and a plain smooth face.

images.why: Phase 1 Wrong line 'the road sign's kilometre is laid out beside the ladder in metre sticks ... the child's two hundred stays in the slot beside the road': the kilometre is a stretch of road the sticks are laid along; its length and marks are drawn in code
images.prompt: A long straight stretch of dusty warm-tan village dirt road, rough mottled soil with many small pebbles and stones of darker and lighter brown scattered over it, and a rougher darker brown edge on each long side.
